metas.name: Octonauts
metas.description: Combines underwater adventure with real marine biology facts, perfect for fans of The Magic School Bus.

metas.name: Wild Kratts
metas.description: Focuses on zoology and ecology through fun 'creature power' adventures, similar to the STEM focus of Ada Twist, Scientist.

metas.name: Daniel Tiger's Neighborhood
metas.description: An excellent social-emotional learning show that mirrors the gentle, family-centric tone of Bluey.

metas.name: StoryBots: Answer Time
metas.description: Uses catchy songs and humor to explain complex questions, appealing to the curiosity found in Curious George.

metas.name: Molly of Denali
metas.description: Teaches kids how to use informational texts and maps, following the educational spirit of Peg + Cat.

metas.name: Tumble Leaf
metas.description: A beautiful stop-motion series that encourages scientific discovery through play and exploration.

metas.name: Arthur
metas.description: A classic series that deals with childhood social situations with the same heart as Clifford the Big Red Dog.

metas.name: Elinor Wonders Why
metas.description: Focuses on the scientific inquiry process, encouraging children to ask questions about the world around them.

metas.name: Blaze and the Monster Machines
metas.description: Integrates STEM concepts like friction and trajectory into high-energy races, similar to Numberblocks' math focus.

metas.name: Team Umizoomi
metas.description: Focuses heavily on math skills and patterns, making it a great companion show to Numberblocks and Peg + Cat.

metas.name: Cyberchase
metas.description: An adventure-filled show that uses math and logic to solve problems, appealing to WordGirl fans.

metas.name: Dinosaur Train
metas.description: Combines two preschool favorites—dinosaurs and trains—to teach natural history and paleontology.

metas.name: Ready Jet Go!
metas.description: Explores astronomy and space science with a fun, musical approach that The Magic School Bus fans will enjoy.

metas.name: Xavier Riddle and the Secret Museum
metas.description: Teaches history by introducing kids to historical figures when they were children, emphasizing character building.

metas.name: The Stinky & Dirty Show
metas.description: Encourages creative problem-solving and engineering through the adventures of a garbage truck and a backhoe loader.

metas.name: Trash Truck
metas.description: A gentle, imaginative series about friendship that captures the wholesome energy of Bluey.

metas.name: Super Why!
metas.description: Helps children build literacy skills by interacting with classic fairy tales, much like WordGirl builds vocabulary.

metas.name: Martha Speaks
metas.description: A show about a talking dog that focuses explicitly on teaching children new vocabulary words in every episode.

metas.name: Wallykazam!
metas.description: Uses magic and play to teach literacy and phonics, perfect for the preschool age group.

metas.name: Wonder Pets!
metas.description: Teaches teamwork and cooperation through operatic adventures, similar to the helpfulness in Special Agent Oso.

metas.name: Little Einsteins
metas.description: Introduces children to classical music and fine art through interactive global adventures.

metas.name: Hero Elementary
metas.description: Features kids with superpowers who use science to solve problems, a great mix of action and education.

metas.name: If You Give a Mouse a Cookie
metas.description: Based on the popular books, it explores cause-and-effect and logic in a whimsical way.

metas.name: Creative Galaxy
metas.description: An interactive art-focused show that encourages children to solve problems through crafts and creativity.

metas.name: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
metas.description: Explores science and nature through the lens of Dr. Seuss's imaginative world.

metas.name: Nature Cat
metas.description: Encourages outdoor exploration and environmental awareness with a comedic touch.

metas.name: Pete the Cat
metas.description: A musical and chill series about staying positive, similar to the relaxed vibe of Bluey.

metas.name: Llama Llama
metas.description: Focuses on childhood milestones and family relationships, echoing the themes in Clifford.

metas.name: Pinkalicious & Peterrific
metas.description: Promotes the arts and creative expression, including music, dance, and visual arts.

metas.name: Alma's Way
metas.description: Focuses on 'thinking through' problems and social conflicts, created by Sonia Manzano from Sesame Street.

metas.name: Work It Out Wombats!
metas.description: Introduces computational thinking and logic to preschoolers through fun, community-based tasks.

metas.name: Rosie's Rules
metas.description: Teaches social studies and how communities work through the eyes of a curious five-year-old.

metas.name: Gabby's Dollhouse
metas.description: Features 'growth mindset' themes and cat-themed crafts that encourage play and resilience.

metas.name: Puffin Rock
metas.description: A gentle and beautifully animated show about nature and family on an Irish island.

metas.name: Bubble Guppies
metas.description: An interactive variety show that covers topics ranging from dinosaurs to recycling through music.

metas.name: Go, Diego, Go!
metas.description: A spin-off of Dora the Explorer that focuses specifically on animal rescue and biological facts.

metas.name: Beat Bugs
metas.description: Teaches life lessons through the music of the Beatles, providing a high-quality audio-visual experience.

metas.name: Miles from Tomorrowland
metas.description: A space-themed adventure that emphasizes family teamwork and futuristic technology concepts.

metas.name: Ridley Jones
metas.description: Follows a young girl who protects a museum where everything comes to life at night, similar to Ada Twist's curiosity.

metas.name: Stillwater
metas.description: Provides gentle lessons on mindfulness and emotional intelligence through beautiful animation.
